name: Find The Trophies
desc:
Welcome to Find The Trophies! Search through the map and collect your favorite Trophy. 

Join our group for free LEGENDARY trophy!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden Trophies!
🧭 Unlock all maps by collecting Trophies!
🏆 Find all Trophies to win!

Some Trophies are very well hidden. Find the Trophies with friends and meet new friends along the way!

82 Trophies
4 Maps

Shoutout to: Find The Markers,  Find The footballers , Find the Memes , Find the Bobas and other find the games

If you want to suggest NEW Trophies post a message on the FindGames group wall. Let us know if you find any bugs.
